entities.summary: Angola is a sovereign nation in Southern Africa, Africa. Its capital is Luanda. Official languages include Portuguese. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 36.7 million. Area: 1,246,700 km². Comprehensive index for Angola covering Kongo Kingdom, Ndongo/Mbundu (Queen Njinga), Portuguese colonisation (oldest in sub-Saharan Africa 1575–1975), Atlantic slave trade centre, liberation movements (MPLA/FNLA/UNITA), civil war 1975–2002 (Cold War proxy), dos Santos era, oil wealth, and Lourenço reforms.
